Headline: O'Hare-bound Blue Line Service Delayed at Illinois Medical District
ShortDescription: O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Illinois Medical District due to a sick rider. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
O'Hare-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Illinois Medical District due to a sick rider.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
